senses.sense_definition: Het verschijnsel waarbij de huid er door kou, schrik of emotie uitziet als die van een geplukte kip.

examples.text: Ik krijg direct <w>kippenvel</w> als ik in de koude wind sta.Het was zo koud buiten dat ik meteen <w>kippenvel</w> kreeg op mijn armen.

target_lang_translations.en: I get <w>goosebumps</w> right away when standing in the cold wind. It was so cold outside that I immediately got <w>goosebumps</w> on my arms.
target_lang_translations.tr: Soğuk rüzgarda durduğumda hemen <w>tüylerim diken diken oluyor</w>. Dışarısı o kadar soğuktu ki kollarımda hemen <w>tüylerim diken diken oldu</w>.

examples.text: Het mooie liedje gaf me spontaan <w>kippenvel</w>. Toen de zangeres begon te zingen, kreeg ik <w>kippenvel</w> van emotie.

target_lang_translations.en: The beautiful song gave me spontaneous <w>goosebumps</w>. When the singer started singing, I got <w>goosebumps</w> from emotion.
target_lang_translations.tr: Bu güzel şarkı kendiliğinden <w>tüylerimi diken diken etti</w>. Şarkıcı söylemeye başladığında duygudan <w>tüylerim ürperdi</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: The phenomenon where the skin looks like that of a plucked chicken due to cold, fear, or emotion.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Soğuk, korku veya heyecan nedeniyle cildin tüyleri yolunmuş tavuk derisine benzemesi durumu.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: bumpy skin from cold or fear
bumpy skin from cold or fear
bumpy skin from cold or fear

senses.sense_definition: Een intense, positieve sensatie veroorzaakt door prachtige kunst, muziek of geluk.

examples.text: Dat prachtige concert bezorgde iedereen een moment van <w>kippenvel</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: That beautiful concert gave everyone a moment of <w>goosebumps</w>.
target_lang_translations.tr: O harika konser herkese <w>tüylerinin ürperdiği</w> anlar yaşattı.

examples.text: Veel mensen ervaren regelmatig <w>kippenvel</w> wanneer ze naar hun favoriete muziek luisteren.

target_lang_translations.en: Many people regularly experience <w>goosebumps</w> when listening to their favorite music.
target_lang_translations.tr: Birçok insan en sevdikleri müziği dinlerken düzenli olarak <w>tüylerinin ürpermesini</w> hisseder.

target_lang_definitions.en: An intense, positive sensation caused by beautiful art, music, or happiness.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Güzel bir sanat eseri, müzik veya mutluluk anında hissedilen yoğun ve olumlu duygu.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: thrill or emotional reaction from music or art

senses.sense_definition: De letterlijke huid van een kip.

examples.text: Voordat je de soep kookt, moet je het <w>kippenvel</w> verwijderen.

target_lang_translations.en: Before you cook the soup, you should remove the <w>chicken skin</w>.
target_lang_translations.tr: Çorbayı pişirmeden önce <w>tavuk derisini</w> çıkarmanız gerekir.

examples.text: Sommige mensen vinden krokant gebakken <w>kippenvel</w> erg lekker.

target_lang_translations.en: Some people find crispy fried <w>chicken skin</w> very delicious.
target_lang_translations.tr: Bazı insanlar çıtır kızarmış <w>tavuk derisini</w> çok lezzetli bulur.

target_lang_definitions.en: The literal skin of a chicken.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the skin of a chicken, as food or culinary ingredient
